interpretation.native_open_claim_limit: Baseline open samples include 239.930173ms (synthetic round3) and 137.632933ms (public round1), with additional variation. They remain in the original mean; no trimming, robust-open-speed guarantee, or unsupported storage/fsync causal explanation is made.

interpretation.high_water_mark_boundary: VmHWM is process lifetime high-water mark at the sampled point, not a phase-only peak or proof of a leak.
interpretation.initialization_cost: The source-free interface certificate remains bound, and actual worker session identities/tokens remain retained; transport or resource comparisons do not remove the approved optional-tool schema cost.

static_import_cost_review.measured_boundary: perf_counter_ns around import memory_book; from memory_book import MemoryBook, before constructing the cohort dataset or MemoryBook database.
static_import_cost_review.unchanged_import_path: __init__.py imports store; store imports segmentation and text; segmentation imports text. Segmentation Git bytes are identical between sources.
certain_new_module_level_work: text.py constructs four new re.compile patterns: _ASCII_LEXICAL_EXCLUSIONS, _NORMALIZATION_IDENTITY, _NORMALIZATION_COMPATIBILITY, _NORMALIZATION_TRANSLATION_RUN.

text.py constructs the 94 fullwidth-ASCII translations and updates them with three explicit mappings, a 97-entry mapping, plus a fixed Unicode-version frozenset and ordinary-function/pattern identity references.
store.py adds an explicit _sqlite3 import statement and captures four native-object aliases, constructs three fixed cursor-description tuples, and defines additional helper/recall code.

Imported store.py grows from 61,126 to 76,301 UTF-8 bytes; text.py grows from 11,145 to 14,804. Larger module bodies can add parsing/bytecode compilation work in fresh source-only workers; this review does not assign measured milliseconds to that mechanism.
static_import_cost_review.excluded_direct_explanation: title_reference.py is imported locally only in recall's opt-in title-follow branch, not by package import. Added T1 branch code still resides in store.py, so this does not exclude all T1-related module-body compilation work.
static_import_cost_review.evidence_limits: No import-time profile, component timing, or counterfactual run was performed. Static source proves additional import-time work but does not partition the observed 6.52710425–7.1336825ms mean increase among regex compilation, Python compilation, module state construction, filesystem effects or other factors. A fully quantified causal explanation remains unresolved.
